scope: Pure model checks use synthetic description text. They do not supply real branch, entry, rights or playback evidence.

checks.name: Literal lines retain original CRLF/blank-line indices, text and separate clue kinds
An unknown restaurant timecode does not create candidate matches
A street-number clue without a known name remains an unassigned address
Ordinary text, incomplete addresses and invalid seconds are not invented as clues
Valid hour/minute timecodes and full-width colon are recognized literally
Empty and oversized descriptions are rejected
A recognized source line longer than 400 characters is rejected rather than clipped
More than 40 clue lines are rejected for segmented review
Only explicitly selected clues are saved and source order wins over click order
Manual candidate choice is retained even when another known name occurs
Observed and published dates remain distinct and valid leap-day dates survive
No selection is rejected
Unknown and duplicate selections are rejected
Only current candidate IDs can receive material
HTTPS source URLs reject credentials and executable or local schemes
Titles and authors obey material limits
Invalid observed or published calendar dates are rejected
An unknown publication date can remain empty
Oversized selected excerpts are rejected before creating a material
Markup remains literal material text without HTML interpretation
Saving a material does not change checks, branch, entrance, media or route prerequisites
Existing 50-material cap still rejects the proposed 51st material on a copy
Catalog and public candidate file stay unchanged
